description: Curated 20-query retrieval-quality probe set. Each probe runs ss-search auto routing against a pinned bench repo and verifies the top-1 result matches `expectedFile` and (when set) `expectedSymbol` / `expectedSymbolType`. Used as a pre-bench regression gate — quick to run, no agent-in-the-loop, no judge model.
